description: Spawns an agent that adds a new slot-registry category to data/slots.json — optionally a full balancing domain (balancing file + schema) — and walks the hardcoded-domain-list checklist so the game, the tests and the skills all learn about it.

fields.description: Registry key, snake_case: the slots.json category key, the balancing file stem, and the branch slug.
fields.label: Category key

fields.description: Label the editor tree shows for this category.
fields.label: Display name

fields.description: True = also a balancing domain: creates data/balancing/<key>.json + data/schemas/<key>.schema.json, and the category gets a balancing form in the editor. False = asset-only (like vfx/deco/backgrounds).
fields.label: Is a balancing domain

fields.description: Sprite frame width in px for every slot in this category (how the SHEET is sliced, not how it draws).
fields.label: Frame width (px)

fields.description: Sprite frame height in px for every slot in this category.
fields.label: Frame height (px)

fields.description: Comma-separated animation vocabulary offered by the importer. MUST start with idle (row 0, E-35). Single-frame art (tiles, deco, backgrounds) uses just 'idle'.
fields.label: Animations

title: Add New Category
